scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
